thread:
maya: Heads up — we've got a reproducible double-charge case for streaming sessions when codec-prefetch + client-side split + truncation happen. Seen on two customer workloads this week.

maya: Repro steps (short): start streaming with codec-prefetch enabled, client does mid-stream split (sends a resume token), new route picks up and requests resume snapshot, server truncates the prefix and replays suffix. Billing ledger shows provisional tokens for the original session and then confirmed tokens again for the resumed suffix.

maya: Example excerpt from runtime logs: 
```
[2026-03-20T19:12:03Z] session=abc123 prefetch=on codec=qat8 resume_token=rtk-9d3 recv_chunk[len=1024] -> truncate_at=768
[2026-03-20T19:12:03Z] billing: provisional_entry id=pfx-abc tokens=768 route=eu-west anchor=none
[2026-03-20T19:12:03Z] session=abc123 handoff -> route=eu-west-2 new_session=def456
[2026-03-20T19:12:04Z] resume: applied snapshot suffix_len=256 -> confirmed_charge tokens=256 entry=cfm-def
[2026-03-20T19:12:04Z] billing: confirmed_entry id=cfm-def tokens=256 parent=pfx-abc
```

sam: Quick q — are the provisional & confirmed entries referencing the same logical token range? or is there an overlap in token index accounting? :thinking:

maya: There's an overlap. The provisional claims tokens 1..768, resume confirmed covers 513..768 (suffix replayed) so tokens 513..768 get effectively counted twice in the ledger snapshot.

jin: This is the classic "orphaned prefix + suffix replay" case when prefetch produces a provisional anchor that isn't reconciled on handoff. Short-term mitigation: attach a session_anchor_id to every provisional entry and on commit have the router include anchor_id in the resume handshake so billing can dedupe overlapping ranges. I'll draft a tiny API patch: 
```
POST /internal/hand_off {
  from_session: "abc123",
  to_session: "def456",
  anchor_id: "anchor-xyz",
  overlap_hint: {start_idx: 513, end_idx: 768}
}
```

ana: console/UX ask: can we show "provisional vs confirmed" token columns in per-route token-breakdown? ops keeps getting paged at 02:00 for these. If users could see provisional buckets and a flag for resume-overlap it would help ops and billing support.

leo: telemetry: add event `stream_resume_truncation` with props {anchor_id, overlap_bytes, codec, prefetch_on, route_from, route_to}. That will let us alert on >1% double-count rate. Sam/analytics can add dashboard.

sam: Also watch tool-calls: if a tool call happens between prefetch provisional and resume commit the tool tokens are currently attached to the new session only and may be double-billed if we don't transfer ownership. Edgecase: function-calling + prefetch.

jin: Agree. For toolcalls the ledger writer must atomically move provisional child entries when anchor is reconciled. Implementation note: writer needs to maintain provisional -> confirmed parent pointers and do a range-dedupe at commit time. This is a small change but needs careful testing for concurrent handoffs.

maya: Short-term ops mitigation request: can we add a provisional-age TTL (e.g., 2s) where provisional entries older than TTL are considered stale and won't be recharged on resume? Might reduce double-charges but risks undercharging on slow networks. Thoughts? :fire:

sam: TTL is a blunt instrument — good as emergency mitigation but we should prefer anchor-based dedupe. If we use TTL, make it a per-customer knob behind feature flag.

jin: I'll open a PR for the anchor_id handshake + ledger dedupe. PR will include unit tests for overlapping ranges, and a small fuzzer for concurrent handoffs.

leo: deploy-bot: staging rollout scheduled 03/22 02:00 UTC for PR #4821 (codec-prefetch-anchor).

maya: Thanks — I'll collect a few real traces and upload to the repro bucket and post links. For tracking: created an internal ticket ENGPLAT-1289.

sam: Thanks — assigning myself and ana to follow-up with console mockups for provisional vs confirmed columns.

ana: will do mockups tomorrow AM, ping me if you want example screenshots from support. :+1:
